PLAN "12-Week Cycle-Synced Strength - Dysmenorrhea Safe"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Progressive strength with flow-day safe recovery"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
